name: Starsealed Edict
desc: A hefty tome containing the Royal Energy Commission's internal rules and procedures, with numerous entries dating back many years.

desc.text:
This was the primeval beginning, before any torch had burned, when the windless mist smothered the skies,
When the oneness of the frozen expanse had not yet welcomed the dawn, indeed, when morning seemed a thousand years away still.
Ideals became the flint stones that ignited frigid nights, and order gave sublime passions the seat of honor,
And people yearned for a new war, to vanquish the blizzard of injustice with love.
And so, a nameless one forged with their hands a torch that could reach the pale star, dedicating it to an unseen tomorrow.
And so, a nameless one did write poems about the wondrous vistas of rising flames, likening them to the stars that hang high in the heavens,
And spellbound by the vision narrated by a nameless commander, the people believed that a will that transcended the laws would birth a miracle:
"There can be no battle without sacrifice in this world. Let us dedicate ourselves to the victory of love! Let our name ring eternal."
The miracle born of passion was unbound by the rules, and the ever-burning flame gave rise to disaster from error,
And the item negligently left within the Kristall mine caused the sound of cracking ice to ring out within the highest torch.
The nameless ones had yet to know fear, and they were willing to venture forth into the scorched earth for the glory of the tundra.
The nameless commander knew that panic cast a shadow greater than calamity, and after much consideration, left the unknown peril unmentioned,
And let the people's hearts be gladdened as they saw them off on the path with no return, crowning their sacrificial courage with laurels woven from their exclamations:
"There can be no battle without sacrifice in this world. Let us dedicate ourselves to the victory of love... and may your names ring eternal."
And so, the nameless ones were buried under nameless headstones, and unnamed deeds became unnamed glories.
The ceaseless incineration ended with sacrifice, the nameless victory was exchanged for a golden medal, and the nameless commander shot up the ranks.
Thus, she came to be remembered, and she wielded the authority to control energy, enabling the Commission to operate under established principles,
And she would never be forgotten, along with the teachings penned by nameless sacrifices and the rules of the past established for her.
Later generations regarded these principles as edicts, for they shone forth eternally like starlight guiding the torch-fires, sustaining the frozen earth,
Breathing life back into the ice-sealed tundra, so that the charred earth should no longer have to hear the lamentations of the nameless.
Yet, in the commander's dreams, she would never forget that the miracles the earth had received were never once granted by the false skies,
And that poems only used the dawnstar as a metaphor for glory, while the nameless ones who had offered themselves up to the cold night would never have their names inscribed.

customize.desc: A hefty tome containing the Royal Energy Commission's internal rules and procedures, with numerous entries dating back many years.

customize.name: Splendor of Tranquil Waters
customize.desc: A scepter around which swirls pure water. In days long past, it once symbolized the highest authority over the seas.

customize.name: Rust
customize.desc: A completely rusted iron greatbow. The average person would lack the strength to even lift it, let alone fire it.

customize.name: The Dockhand's Assistant
customize.desc: A convenient cutting tool that you can rarely find nowadays. You can replace the blades as they are dulled by usage.

customize.name: Dawning Frost
customize.desc: A silver-forged ritual vessel, pure and completely without blemish. It is said to be a sacred relic passed down for generations among the priestesses of the far north.

customize.name: Prospector's Drill
customize.desc: A long-handled drill that you can rarely find nowadays. It was often used in delving and in carving stones.

customize.name: Rainslasher
customize.desc: A fluorescent greatsword with no sharp edge that crushes enemies with brute force and raw power.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: The Frost Emperor's Revival
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The hero who emerged from the snowfields had yet to become the ruler of that frozen realm, but even then, he had already shown a habit of confiding far too much to those around him.
So he was all the more surprised when he received a gift from the fae of snow, who at the time had not yet taken their human form.
As far as he knew, he never told them that he was born from an egg as pale as ice deep within the wing-like mountains, nor did he ever mention the date of his birth.

materials.name: Snowborn Heartshard
materials.desc:
A remnant left behind when a monster formed from ice and snow fades away.
Some believe these wintry monsters to be a kind of Snezhnayan fae, yet what they leave behind bears almost no resemblance to the crystals that grow upon a fae's body...

materials.name: Ethereal Glimmershard
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
These shards once coated the creature's body like crystalline scales. Upon falling away, they stripped themselves of all colors, shifting into something akin to the dusty dross of a moth's wings.

materials.name: The Frost Emperor's Ceremony
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The fae of the court didn't understand why a gift meant for the Tsar must be made in such shape. They knew only to lavish their craft upon ornaments bright as jewels.
Only the Tsar seated upon the throne and the fae of snow understood the meaning behind it.
For what mattered was never the ceremony, but the ancient truth it preserved.

materials.name: Snowborn Mirrorheart
materials.desc:
A remnant left behind when a monster formed from ice and snow fades away.
For reasons unknown, the creature possesses no intelligence with which to communicate, yet bears a fierce hostility toward certain targets. It is as though that hatred was etched into its very being the moment it took form.

materials.name: Ethereal Crystal
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A shattered fragment of the crystalline scales that once grew upon the fae's body. Though it is now a mere empty shell, one can still sense the echo of the unique power that once dwelt within.

materials.name: The Frost Emperor's Lament
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
On the night the truth stirred like bitter waves, she prepared this gift for her friend upon the throne—though she herself was no longer the person she used to be.
They both seemed to understand that they might never speak to each other like this again.
For after that night, the path they once walked together diverged—sundered by the weakness of one, and the fury of the other.

materials.name: Snowborn Heart of Ignorance
materials.desc:
A remnant left behind when a monster formed from ice and snow fades away.
Under the influence of some unknown, overwhelming power, these monsters, at once humanoid and beastlike, take form in a way unlike ordinary elemental beings. The proof lies in the power core they leave behind, its jagged growths jutting outward like the unruly scales of some primeval creature.

materials.name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.

materials.name: The Frost Emperor's Farewell
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
An object that appeared upon the table on the eve of war, though none knew when or how it'd come to be there.
He recognized it for the handiwork of the friend he hadn't seen for many long years.
Only then did he realize, that this was the beginning of every calamity, the bitter fruit of every desire, and the omen of every destruction.

value.text:
Increases CRIT DMG by <color=#36ffff>24%/30%/36%/42%/48%</color> . The equipping character gains the Crystal Compounding effect when they use their Elemental Skill, increasing Elemental Mastery by <color=#36ffff>48/60/72/84/96</color> for 20s. During this time, the equipping character gains a Law of Combustion stack when a nearby party member triggers an Elemental Reaction. Each stack increases Elemental Mastery by an additional <color=#36ffff>24/30/36/42/48</color> . Max 3 stacks. These stacks last until Crystal Compounding ends or the equipping character uses their Elemental Skill again.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Each Law of Combustion stack also increases the equipping character's Stellar-Conduct CRIT DMG by <color=#36ffff>12%/15%/18%/21%/24%</color> .
These effects can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
